## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (65%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Reliability flag is on and InSitu stays in the conformal set.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 65%, InSitu 29% | Benign leads, InSitu plausible |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90%) | Two classes not separable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.77 / 100th percentile | Flagged; input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Models disagree |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign; all InSitu | Neighbors disagree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 1, 5, 6) · context · 93% neoplastic nuclei, 100th percentile; sampled regions only [F7] · Measured
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Near-typical score; lowers invasive estimate in concept model [F4] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 7, 10) · context · Above-typical score; spot check 8/20 [F2] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 4, 7, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score; spot check 0/20 [F3] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion CI excludes 0 (+0.54 logit); heatmap is faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0, so concepts are not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses is Unreliable here.

## Could be wrong if
- Image is out of distribution (100th percentile); probabilities may be off.
- InSitu is a close second (29%) and all 5 similar reference cases are InSitu.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 5**: highest regional invasive probability (26%); look for stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 1, 5, 6**: confirm segmentation's 93% neoplastic nuclei are truly tumor.
3. **Regions 7, 10**: check mitoses and lymphocytes; mitosis score failed its spot check.
